title: Puka Nacua: I haven't really thought about playing 2026 without a contract extension

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Puka Nacua: I haven't really thought about playing 2026 without a contract extension
sources.description: Rams wide receiver Puka Nacua's trip to rehab was his major offseason storyline and he discussed that decision during a press conference from the team's OTAs on Thursday.
